dataset_source: Tavallaee et al., 'A Detailed Analysis of the KDD CUP 99 Data Set' (2009). Files: KDDTrain+.txt / KDDTest+.txt
anomaly_threshold_method: 10% quantile of normal training anomaly scores (unsupervised; nominal 10% FPR on normal traffic; recall-oriented operating point; no attack labels or test data used)

class_weighting.note: Cost-sensitive weighting for class imbalance, selected on a stratified validation split of KDDTrain+ (scripts/experiment_detection.py); KDDTest+ held out.
